mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Verona Community Park with a Waxing Crescent moon. You can spot the ISS tomorrow morning at 5:35 AM as it rises over Mount Horeb and travels toward Fitchburg, appearing almost directly overhead. Expect an overnight low of 62 degrees with no rain.

The city council has approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates to cover essential maintenance and prevent future service failures, with the average home seeing an increase of 26 dollars per quarter. Additionally, the city has revealed the four student winners of the I Voted sticker contest who will have their artwork displayed on stickers at local polling places this November.

Today, Epic is hosting their annual User Group Meeting. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company. You can also look forward to trivia at Paddy Mac's, the Downtown Farmer's Market, and a concert in the park later this week.
Regarding the weekly police report, on last Friday, August 15, a local woman was arrested for her first O W I offence after being found passed out behind the wheel near North Main Street.

Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup, and you can pick it up until the store closes at 10 PM. Also, don't miss out on Kona Ice, which will be at the Concerts at McKee party tonight from 5 PM to 9 PM.
